original: WPRPLACE is a large area of unusually shaped lava fields east of Mývatn in Iceland. The WPRPLACE area is composed of various volcanic caves and rock formations, reminiscent of an ancient collapsed citadel . The dramatic structures are one of Iceland's most popular natural tourist attractions.
